Subject: POC trial environment setup — hosted vs dedicated sandbox vs VPC

Hi Sarah — great run through earlier today, and thanks for sharing your goals. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the POC moving.

Recap of objectives (as discussed):
- Evaluate Redwood for latency-sensitive real-time scoring in your payments product (p95 target and consistency)
- Validate model quality on your transaction classification prompts (accuracy + false positive tolerances)
- Measure unit economics at expected throughput (tokens/cost per 1k) and scaling behavior under 50–200 TPS bursts

POC success criteria (draft):
1) Latency: p95 <= 250ms for the 512-token scenario under baseline load
2) Quality: >= 92% on the provided eval set (FinTechCo transactions v1) with no high-severity regressions
3) Cost: projected cost per 1k tokens within target range you share (we can model multiple configs)
4) Operational: model serving stability for a 2-week trial (no more than 1 outage >5min)

Environment options (tradeoffs):
- Hosted trial (fastest): Redwood-hosted sandbox, zero infra setup on your side, 1–2 business days to provision. Good for getting early signals.
- Dedicated sandbox (reserved capacity): isolated GPU pool behind your account, predictable throughput, ~5 business days to provision depending on sizing.
- VPC trial (best for security/regulatory): customer VPC peering or private deployment; requires IT/network coordination and security review; ~2–3 weeks typical for initial onboarding.

From our side we recommend starting with a 2-week hosted sandbox to validate the evaluation set and latency assumptions, and then switch to a dedicated sandbox or VPC trial for production-like testing if you want network isolation. If you must run the POC in your VPC from day one, we can support that but will need the network checklist and a security kickoff meeting.

Attachments: POC-runbook.pdf (trial playbook), trial-options.csv (cost/latency tradeoff grid).

Proposed timeline / owners:
- This week: agree on success criteria + sign POC mutual action plan (you + Redwood) — owner: Sarah (FinTechCo) and Marissa (Redwood)
- Week 1: provision hosted sandbox (if agreed) and ingest eval set — owner: Dev (Redwood) + FinTechCo IT for data access
- Week 2: run evaluation, share interim results; plan for dedicated/VPC if needed — owner: Marissa/Rishi

Next steps — please confirm:
1) Which environment do you prefer to start with? (hosted / dedicated sandbox / VPC)
2) Confirm the internal owners and a primary IT contact for network/security (email + availability)
3) Any restrictions on data (e.g., PII redaction) we should be aware of before provisioning

If that looks good I’ll schedule a 30-minute kickoff for early next week and loop in our security engineer for the checklist.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this rolling.

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
